reviewer_authorship: Independent source and execution-readiness review; no product or test edits.

evidence: The executable driver asks the native harness for headed mode and exact unpacked development receipt/tree/version/extension identity verification.

It exercises the real panel controls through admin sign-in and device organization selection on an owned repeated-card fixture; it cancels A, starts B on the same page, selects a card/title, extracts three known rows, cancels again, and checks one ordinary click afterward.
T24 is only partial: cancellation/replacement and extraction are exercised, but its Done transfer and separate Restart expectations are not fully covered.
T51 is only partial: manual nested-card scope choice/extraction is exercised, but the Doctor-seeded add-fields path, alternate nested scope extraction, and electronic.vegas target are absent.

D42 remains unverified for held stale ITEM_DETECTED/RESULT/EXIT delivery, delayed A cancellation injection, deferred installation, and fresh-context reinjection/listener counts. A successful bounded run cannot close D42.
verdict_A_readiness_and_coverage.live_limit: No browser/native run was performed in this peer review; the cited CI artifact still needs a fresh independent hosted run.

evidence: Hosted route requires the CI development artifact and admin credentials, copies credentials to a mode-0600 private file, then removes credential JSON from child environment.
Native harness owns a fresh profile and spawned browser, checks headed command-line mode, extension identity, SIDE_PANEL context, and verifies the exact artifact receipt/tree before controls.
Resource health is checked before and after the flow, and each UI/navigation action passes through the resource boundary.
The driver writes a bounded report with stage-specific failure codes and avoids serializing thrown exception text or credential values.
lightweight_checks: Inspected commit diff, relevant inventory T24/T51 records, D42 closure requirement, hosted route and harness boundaries.
No browser, build, release, or test execution in this review.
